summary.headline: Role plays reviewing the Travel booking words (7ajez, ba7jez, tazkara, maw3ed), plus a dual (-ain) recap

rules.title: Two of something = -ain on the end: saa3tain, santain, bentain, waladain
bullets: No word for two: saa3a -> saa3tain (two hours), sane -> santain (two years)
benet -> bentain, walad -> waladain; zalame -> zalamain (treated as masculine because its meaning is men)
b3eed saa3tain = two hours away; a5adni sa3tain = it took me two hours
